recognize_zh: 骨髓中巨核細胞呈多個分離的圓形核葉（separated lobes），並可見巨核細胞的有絲分裂像（抹片中的濃縮染色體團塊與切片中的中期板），加上顆粒異常的顆粒球與芽細胞，指向多系發育不良的 AML。
features: Increased blasts and hypogranular myeloid precursors with irregular nuclei (panel A)
Dysplastic megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes (panel B)
Megakaryocytes with condensed chromatin masses representing mitotic figures on aspirate (panel C)
Megakaryocyte mitotic figure with a metaphase-like chromosome plate on H&E biopsy (panel D)
Auer rods not clearly resolved at this image resolution
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show increased blasts and hypogranular myeloid cells with nuclear irregularity. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes, and several show condensed chromatin clumps consistent with mitotic figures. The core biopsy highlights a megakaryocyte containing a metaphase-like mitotic figure within a cellular marrow. Findings demonstrate multilineage dysplasia with megakaryocyte mitoses; with 40% blasts by flow cytometry and myelodysplasia-related mutations, they are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplasia related.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes have normally connected hyperlobated nuclei, with rare mitoses and no increase in blasts.
AMKL is dominated by megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 expression rather than mature dysplastic megakaryocytes with myeloid blasts.
Morphology may be similar, and separation rests on the blast count (≥20% for AML) by aspirate differential and flow cytometry.
Tumor giant cells form cohesive clusters with atypical mitoses and are keratin positive and CD61 negative.
